summary_en: This Phase 1b study tests fostamatinib, a Syk kinase inhibitor approved for chronic idiopathic thrombocytopenia purpura, added to gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel chemotherapy around surgery for resectable, non-metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Participants take fostamatinib 100 mg by mouth twice a day for 7 days before chemotherapy and then during it, while gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel are given by vein on days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle; the total number of cycles is not stated. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is a Phase 1b trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1b evalúa fostamatinib, un inhibidor de la quinasa Syk aprobado para la púrpura trombocitopénica idiopática crónica, añadido a la quimioterapia con gemcitabina y nab-paclitaxel alrededor de la cirugía para el adenocarcinoma ductal de páncreas resecable y no metastásico. Los participantes toman fostamatinib 100 mg por vía oral dos veces al día durante 7 días antes de la quimioterapia y luego durante esta, mientras que la gemcitabina y el nab-paclitaxel se administran por vena los días 1, 8 y 15 de cada ciclo de 28 días; el número total de ciclos no se indica. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 1b.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who can give written informed consent
ECOG performance status of 1 or less
Resectable primary pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma on recent CT or MRI
Confirmed surgical candidate by surgical consult within 28 days before enrollment
Adequate blood counts, liver, kidney and bilirubin levels
not_for: Any prior treatment for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
Investigational agent within 28 days before first study dose, or major surgery within 28 days
